mapper.select: SELECT m.menu_id, m.menu_name, m.menu_name_en, m.price, m.category, m.image_url, m.description, m.description_en, m.is_available, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM menu_set ms JOIN menus component ON component.menu_id = ms.component_menu_id WHERE ms.set_menu_id = m.menu_id AND ( component.is_available = FALSE OR component.is_visible = FALSE ) ) THEN FALSE ELSE m.is_available END AS effective_available, m.is_visible, m.sold_out_reason, m.created_at, m.updated_at FROM menus m ORDER BY m.menu_id ASC

SELECT m.menu_id, m.menu_name, m.menu_name_en, m.price, m.category, m.image_url, m.description, m.description_en, m.is_available, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM menu_set ms JOIN menus component ON component.menu_id = ms.component_menu_id WHERE ms.set_menu_id = m.menu_id AND ( component.is_available = FALSE OR component.is_visible = FALSE ) ) THEN FALSE ELSE m.is_available END AS effective_available, m.is_visible, m.sold_out_reason, m.created_at, m.updated_at FROM menus m WHERE m.menu_id = #{menuId}

SELECT component.menu_id, component.menu_name, component.menu_name_en, component.price, component.category, component.image_url, component.description, component.description_en, component.is_available, component.is_visible, component.sold_out_reason, component.created_at, component.updated_at FROM menu_set ms JOIN menus component ON component.menu_id = ms.component_menu_id WHERE ms.set_menu_id = #{menuId} ORDER BY component.menu_id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO menus ( menu_name, menu_name_en, price, category, image_url, description, description_en, is_available, is_visible, sold_out_reason ) VALUES ( #{menuName}, #{menuNameEn}, #{price}, #{category}, #{imageUrl}, #{description}, #{descriptionEn}, #{isAvailable}, true, #{soldOutReason} )
mapper.update:
UPDATE menus
menu_name = #{menuName}, menu_name_en = #{menuNameEn}, price = #{price}, category = #{category},
image_url = #{imageUrl},
description = #{description}, description_en = #{descriptionEn}, is_available = #{isAvailable}, sold_out_reason = #{soldOutReason}, updated_at = NOW()
WHERE menu_id = #{menuId}
UPDATE menus SET is_visible = false, is_available = false, updated_at = NOW() WHERE menu_id = #{menuId}
UPDATE menus SET is_visible = true, is_available = true, sold_out_reason = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE menu_id = #{menuId}
